info.name: Getting Started with Passport Global Cart API
Request rates for shipping, duties, and taxes for an order

items.docs:
Brands can send information to this endpoint to receive rates (shipping, duties & taxes) for an order.
Rates can be configured by contacting Passport for each country & service level:
- Shipping: Live, flat, free, free with threshold
- Duties: Live, free
- Taxes: Live, free

Rates can also be received in the desired local currency.
